title: Comparing PAS domain-coupled intrinsic dynamics in bHLH-PAS domain transcription factor complexes.
authors: Sudarsanam, Karthik; Srivastava, Ashutosh; Tiwari, Sandhya P
one_liner_zh: 该文用ENM与MD模拟比较bHLH-PAS转录因子复合物中PAS结构域的固有动态，聚焦TF-DNA复合物中蛋白-蛋白界面耦合运动，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: The basic helix-loop-helix Per-Arnt-Sim (bHLH-PAS) transcription factors (TFs) are regulators of several critical cellular functions such as circadian rhythm, hypoxia response, and neuronal development. Although PAS domains adopt a conserved fold, recent studies suggest that their interaction interfaces differ distinctly in different TF complexes. However, the implications of these differences on the intrinsic dynamics of PAS domains remain unclear. In this study, we performed a comparative analysis of PAS domain dynamics across multiple bHLH-PAS TF complexes using all-atom elastic network model (ENM)-based normal mode analysis and molecular dynamics simulations. We decomposed the intrinsic dynamics of PAS domains using a domain-domain coupled motions analysis method into self-coupled (internal domain dynamics) and directly coupled (interaction partner-influenced dynamics) motions using a projection-based approach. Our results show that self-coupled motions are more conserved across PAS domains than structure or sequence alone, whereas directly coupled motions capture the context-specific influence of partner proteins. Furthermore, hierarchical clustering of the overall covariance-based similarity scores revealed distinct grouping of CLOCK:BMAL1-type and HIF:ARNT-type complexes, which were not captured by sequence or structural comparisons. Root mean-square fluctuation profiles derived from both molecular dynamics and the all-atom ENM normal mode analysis-based approaches showed strong correspondence, validating the utility of ENMs and domain-domain coupled motions analysis in capturing biologically relevant dynamics, even in cases where the structural complexes were modeled using AlphaFold3. PAS-B domains were generally found to be less flexible than PAS-A domains for all the complexes analyzed. Regions with high directly coupled flexibility were generally localized regions with high interface propensity in class I PAS-B domains, suggesting a higher level of coupled dynamics between PAS-B domains. Our results highlight how PAS domain intrinsic dynamics are shaped by both their internal architecture and complex-specific interactions, offering new insights into the functional diversification of bHLH-PAS TFs.
abstract_zh: 碱性螺旋-环-螺旋Per-Arnt-Sim（bHLH-PAS）转录因子（TFs）是多种关键细胞功能（如昼夜节律、低氧反应和神经元发育）的调控因子。尽管PAS结构域采用保守的折叠方式，但近期研究表明，其相互作用界面在不同TF复合物中存在显著差异。然而，这些差异对PAS结构域内在动力学的影响仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们利用全原子弹性网络模型（ENM）基于的正则模式分析和分子动力学模拟，对多个bHLH-PAS TF复合物中的PAS结构域动力学进行了比较分析。我们采用基于投影的域-域耦合运动分析方法，将PAS结构域的内在动力学分解为自耦合运动（内部结构域动力学）和直接耦合运动（受相互作用伙伴影响的动力学）。结果表明，自耦合运动在PAS结构域间的保守性高于单独的结构或序列，而直接耦合运动则捕捉了伙伴蛋白的上下文特异性影响。此外，基于整体协方差相似性分数的层次聚类揭示了CLOCK:BMAL1型和HIF:ARNT型复合物的明显分组，这些分组在序列或结构比较中未被捕获。从分子动力学和全原子ENM正则模式分析方法得到的均方根涨落曲线显示出强烈的一致性，验证了ENM和域-域耦合运动分析在捕捉生物学相关动力学方面的有效性，即使在结构复合物通过AlphaFold3建模的情况下也是如此。在所有分析的复合物中，PAS-B结构域通常比PAS-A结构域灵活性更低。高直接耦合灵活性的区域通常位于I类PAS-B结构域中高界面倾向性的局部区域，表明PAS-B结构域之间具有更高水平的耦合动力学。我们的结果突显了PAS结构域内在动力学如何受其内部架构和复合物特异性相互作用的共同塑造，为bHLH-PAS TFs的功能多样化提供了新见解。
